signals.literal: We can not find the fiction you're looking for.

notes: The site publishes one explicit empty-result string, and it lives only on its 404 page: "We can not find the fiction you're looking for." It therefore discriminates for search, novel-details and chapter-content lookups, and for NOTHING else. A catalogue or genre listing that genuinely holds zero rows is an ordinary, well-formed page on this site, so browsing has TWO states, not three: zero rows is a suspected break (E8), never "no results". The UI must say it cannot distinguish rather than render a third state it did not measure. Measured against the 9 frozen fixtures of 2026-10-03; re-derived by test/domain/sources/empty_signal_test.dart on every run.
